description: Day trip planner: local leads around a destination for a same-day trip. Pass destination (place name) or lat and lon; optional origin, date, radius_miles (default 25), interests and theme. Returns JSON with breweries and place candidates found inside the radius, plus general planning notes and a transit strategy from a curated registry, each labelled in data_basis. Hours, fees and closures are not verified. $0.10 via x402; not charged when the place cannot be located or no local leads are found. This MCP never pays: it returns the live result if the backend answers, or the request URL and x402 payment metadata for a client that can pay.
name: plan_day_trip
